topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 60 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 5 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 12 common project-authored base contract(s) (accesscontrols, adminaccess, boringbatchable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
